reason: Lujo-MCP is primarily a testing and debugging context server that captures runtime, browser, network, and trace data and exposes structured diagnostics to MCP-compatible AI coding clients.

summaries.zh: Lujo-MCP 是一个通过 MCP 为 AI 编程客户端提供浏览器、网络和运行时调试上下文的调试追踪服务。
summaries.en: Lujo-MCP is an MCP debugging and tracing service that provides AI coding clients with structured browser, network, and runtime diagnostics.

capabilities: Captures browser runtime errors, console logs, user interactions, and network request and response data
Collects backend traces, stack traces, runtime snapshots, and structured debugging context
Persists errors and debugging experiences in memory or PostgreSQL and optionally uses Redis or Qdrant
Exposes debugging tools through MCP stdio and Streamable HTTP transports
Optionally sends debugging context to configured external LLM providers
